--- alter_queue_on_delete_no_action.sql
ALTER QUEUE Q SET ON DELETE NO ACTION

--- AST
&ast.AlterQueue{
  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 12,
        NameEnd: 13,
        Name:    "Q",
      },
    },
  },
  QueueAlteration: &ast.SetOnDelete{
    Set:         14,
    OnDeleteEnd: 37,
    OnDelete:    "ON DELETE NO ACTION",
  },
}

--- SQL
ALTER QUEUE Q SET ON DELETE NO ACTION
